title: Mist violation inventory
$comment: The machine-readable source of truth for VIOLATIONS.md. The Markdown is GENERATED and never hand-edited; scripts/check-violations.mjs fails on a byte difference. Four classes, taken verbatim from docs/mist-concept-evaluation.md:62, joined to the CI-1..CI-6 ids in docs/ANTI_KERNEL.md. `none` is a first-class class rather than an omission: if a dependency can simply be absent, the completeness check has nothing to assert and 'maintained' becomes unverifiable.

subject.description: A package name, or a first-party path:line.

party.$comment: The claim Mist makes is that its defects are second-party and emergent while Juice Shop's are first-party and curated (docs/mist-concept-evaluation.md:68). That claim is only credible if the first-party ones are counted honestly too.

class.$comment: Verbatim from docs/mist-concept-evaluation.md:62. Do not invent a fifth.

evidence.$comment: Every item must RESOLVE against the tree (scripts/lib/evidence.mjs). A violation with unresolvable evidence is a claim, and claims do not go in the exhibit (EPIC-05 Scope rule 4).

attribution.description: For a transitive behaviour attributed to a direct dependency: which package actually declares it.
